author: Salem Techsperts
description: If you have an OG PS5 or Slim, replace your liquid metal NOW! The OG PS5 and PS5 Slim's had a design flaw that was fixed in late 2023 where, if the console was used vertically for extended periods, the liquid metal would pool at the bottom, leaving a dry spot on the CPU. This dry spot would overheat and the PS5 would shut down. This doesn't apply to the PS5 Pro
title: Your PS5 is COOKING Itself! #tech #pc #technology #shorts
